name: Tm Headline Cards
pitch: One card per category: the latest number, its change with ▲▼ and a trend. Set layout, change, trend and look.
question: How is each category doing right now, and which way is it heading?
questions: Which product lines are ahead of plan this month?
Which regions grew, and which slipped, since last period?
Is a dip this month a blip or part of a longer trend?
useWhen: Show the latest value and trend for a few categories.
audience: Managers and BI leads who need a compact status for up to 24 categories on one sheet.
features: Stacked, compact or side by side cards
Line, area, column or win-loss trends
Change as difference, percent or both
Status colour, or your own colour rule
Styled in Qlik's own Styling panel
Click, hover and link to a detail sheet

featureStrips.heading: Three layouts for three kinds of sheet
featureStrips.text: Stacked cards for a few big numbers, compact cards for a dense grid, side by side for a row of wide cards next to a table.
featureStrips.alt: Three variants: stacked sales cards, compact web channel cards sorted by change, and side by side support team cards.

featureStrips.heading: Set it up in the Appearance section
featureStrips.text: Every option lives in Qlik's own property panel: layout, labels, headline, both comparisons, trend, link, tooltip and status colour.
featureStrips.alt: The Qlik property panel open on the Appearance section of Tm Headline Cards, next to the cards on the sheet.

featureStrips.heading: Four ways to draw the trend
featureStrips.text: A line with its latest, highest and lowest points; an area or columns from zero; or win and loss marks against plan.
featureStrips.alt: The same two cards drawn as a marked line, an area from zero, columns from zero and win and loss bars.

featureStrips.heading: Reference lines and one shared scale
featureStrips.text: Draw last year or the plan as a dashed line, or the average. A shared scale shows which category is really bigger.
featureStrips.alt: Six web channel cards with last year dashed, next to the same cards on one shared scale with an average line.

featureStrips.heading: Honest about missing and late data
featureStrips.text: A month without data is a gap, not a joined line. A team that reports late is muted and named with its last month.
featureStrips.alt: Five support team cards: Returns has a gap in its trend, and Enterprise is muted with Sep 2026 under its value.

featureStrips.heading: Show the change your way
featureStrips.text: A difference, a percent or both, with a triangle or an arrow and your own label. The sign always shows the direction.
featureStrips.alt: Three columns of the same cards: change as a dollar difference, as a percent, and as both with an arrow and own label.

featureStrips.heading: When lower is better
featureStrips.text: For times, costs or errors, a rise is bad. Set lower is better, a neutral band for small moves, and tint the card.
featureStrips.alt: Support resolution times against the SLA: teams under it tinted green, over it tinted red, small changes left plain.

featureStrips.heading: A total headline and a second target
featureStrips.text: Give a measure the Headline role, such as a year to date total, and add a second comparison, such as a stretch plan.
featureStrips.alt: Four side by side cards with a total headline, changes against plan and stretch plan, and win and loss bars.

featureStrips.heading: Colour cards by your own rule
featureStrips.text: A colour expression on the value sets each card's colour, for example purple when a channel grew more than 10%.
featureStrips.alt: Six outlined web channel cards with top accent bars: two purple from a colour rule, the others green or red.

featureStrips.heading: Style it in Qlik's Styling panel
featureStrips.text: Plain, outlined or filled cards, corner radius, padding, an accent bar, and the font size and colour of each part.
featureStrips.alt: The Qlik Styling panel open on the Chart tab with the card style options, next to outlined cards on the sheet.

featureStrips.heading: Fits a big, medium or tiny object
featureStrips.text: Small cards drop the label and indicator, then the trend, then the change. The number stays whole and abbreviates.
featureStrips.alt: The same cards at three sizes: with trends, smaller without trends, and names and numbers only.

featureStrips.heading: Click, hover and open a detail sheet
featureStrips.text: Click a name or point to select. Hover or focus a point for its numbers. A footer link opens a detail sheet.
featureStrips.alt: Three sales cards with Open details links, and a tooltip on one trend point showing month, sales, plan and change.
